meta.title: Sealbid enabling is refused when the tenant does not allow it
gaps: Establish or verify that the tenant has sealbid_allowed disabled.
Locate the sealed-bidding control and assert that it is absent or refuses enabling without misleadingly appearing on.
Reload and assert that the sealed-bidding setting persists as off.
Inspect the vendor's view and assert that bidding is unsealed, agreeing with the buyer's persisted setting.
